# Tokyo Express: is this state "held" for anchor election purposes?
# Held = controlled by Japan itself (user ruling 2026-07-15; the faction-wide form
# was retired the same day - it let runs buff any coast-holding ally, e.g. a Japan-

# the JAP_te_supply enable so icons only appear where a run would actually land.
# Evaluated in STATE scope from JAP_te_refresh_anchors_effect (auto-generated).
